statements.impact_statement: Risk accepted in the pull request adding this statement. containerd/v2 2.3.4 vendored in the Docker Scout CLI binary. The flaw is a panic of the containerd daemon transfer service on a malformed manifest annotation, the CLI runs no daemon and a crash would only abort a scan. Fixed in containerd 2.3.7, remove when docker/scout-cli ships it.

Risk accepted in the pull request adding this statement. golang.org/x/net 0.60.0 vendored in the Docker Scout CLI binary. Quadratic cost of the x/net/html parser, neither the scanner nor image-scan parses untrusted HTML. Fixed in x/net 0.62.0, remove when docker/scout-cli ships it.

Risk accepted in the pull request adding this statement. klauspost/compress 1.18.7 vendored in the Docker Scout CLI binary. A crafted zstd frame can panic the decoder, the only data decoded are the layers of the image this action scans, built by this repository. Fixed in 1.20.2, remove when docker/scout-cli ships it.

Risk accepted in the pull request adding this statement. docker/cli (29.5.3 in the Docker Scout CLI binary, 29.7.2 through go-containerregistry). The flaw is the Windows plugin lookup in C:\ProgramData\Docker\cli-plugins, the image is linux only and loads no CLI plugin. No fixed version published.

Risk accepted in the pull request adding this statement. git 2.54.1 of Alpine 3.24. The flaw needs git clone --recurse-submodules of an attacker repository, image-scan only runs git diff on the bind-mounted checkout of the caller and never clones. Fixed in git 2.56.1, remove when Alpine 3.24 ships it.

Risk accepted in the pull request adding this statement. git 2.54.1 of Alpine 3.24. The flaw is in the three-way merge (xdiff), image-scan only runs git diff, never a merge. Fixed in git 2.56.1, remove when Alpine 3.24 ships it.

Risk accepted in the pull request adding this statement. musl 1.2.6-r3 of Alpine 3.24. The flaw is regcomp with an untrusted regular expression, image-scan matches with the Go regexp package and its git diff compiles no pattern from the scanned repository. Fixed in musl 1.2.6-r6, remove when Alpine 3.24 ships it.
